name: Shrey Sandeep Jain
projectDesc: Analyze customer behavior and subscription churn datasets using Excel, SQL, and Power BI/Python to identify churn drivers, calculate customer lifetime value, and build an interactive retention monitoring dashboard.
tools: Excel, SQL (PostgreSQL/SQLite), Power BI Desktop, Python (pandas, matplotlib), GitHub
responsibilities: Collect and clean raw data from various sources.
Analyze datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights.
Create reports and dashboards to visualize findings.
Interpret data to support business decisions.
Perform data validation to ensure accuracy and consistency.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as product managers and designers.
Use statistical techniques to solve business problems and forecast trends.
Build and maintain databases or data systems.
Present insights to stakeholders in a clear, actionable manner.
Develop and automate data pipelines for efficient processing.
Ensure data security and compliance with organizational policies.
weekTasks: Project Kickoff & Data Exploration — Download a public telecom/SaaS customer churn dataset (CSV), review column descriptions in a data dictionary, and verify data types.
Data Cleaning & Formatting — Clean raw dataset in Excel or Python pandas: remove duplicate rows, fill missing values, and standardize payment methods and tenure fields.
Database Setup & SQL Queries — Import cleaned data into SQLite or PostgreSQL, write basic SQL queries to count total customers, active subscribers, and calculate overall churn rate.
Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) — Run SQL aggregations and Python plots to find churn trends across contract types (month-to-month vs. annual), monthly charges, and internet services.
Key Retention Metrics — Compute core business metrics in Excel: Monthly Churn Rate, Retention Rate, Average Revenue Per User (ARPU), and Customer Lifetime Value (CLV).
Summary Charts & Visuals — Build standard visual charts: churn distribution pie chart, revenue comparison bar chart, and a customer tenure histogram.
Interactive Dashboard Build — Build an interactive Power BI dashboard featuring summary KPI cards and filter slicers for contract type, gender, and payment method.
Automated Data Pipeline Script — Write a simple Python script (churn_pipeline.py) that loads new customer records, cleans them, and flags high-risk churn accounts into an alert CSV file.
Data Validation & Quality Checks — Perform reconciliation checks ensuring dashboard totals match database SQL query results and raw source data with 100% accuracy.
Analytical Findings Report — Write a 2-page executive summary document detailing top churn risk factors and 3 actionable business retention recommendations.
Stakeholder Presentation Deck — Create an 8-slide presentation in Google Slides or PowerPoint with dashboard screenshots and data-backed business takeaways.
Final Packaging & GitHub Portfolio — Organize all SQL scripts, Python files, and dashboard exports; write a clear README.md file and upload the project to GitHub.

name: Sana Samad
project: Omnichannel Order Management & Fulfillment Process Optimization
projectDesc: Conduct end-to-end business analysis for retail order fulfillment operations. Document AS-IS vs. TO-BE workflows, author user stories and a complete Business Requirements Document (BRD), and design an operational KPI dashboard.
tools: draw.io, Google Docs / Word, Google Sheets / Excel, Jira / Trello, Power BI / Excel, GitHub
responsibilities: Gather, analyze, and interpret business requirements to identify needs, trends, and opportunities.
Develop and maintain business requirements, process documents, and visualizations for stakeholders.
Collect, document, and validate requirements to ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency.
Perform business analysis to support strategic planning and business decision-making.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and objectives.
Identify process improvement opportunities through business analysis and recommendations.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and track business performance and project metrics.
Conduct ad hoc analysis to address business challenges and support operational needs.
Create and maintain documentation for requirements, processes, workflows, and analytical activities.
Ensure requirements alignment, governance, and compliance with organizational standards.
Present analytical findings, business solutions, and actionable recommendations to management and stakeholders.
weekTasks: Project Charter & Scope Definition — Draft project charter outlining business goals, project scope (in-scope vs. out-of-scope), and success criteria for improving order fulfillment.
Stakeholder Analysis Matrix — Create stakeholder register identifying key roles (Sales, Warehouse, Support, Customer), their primary pain points, and business requirements.
AS-IS Process Flow Mapping — Map the current manual order fulfillment workflow in draw.io using swimlane diagrams, highlighting delays and manual handoffs.
Gap & Root Cause Analysis — Document operational bottlenecks causing order delays and compare current process steps against industry standard fulfillment SLAs.
TO-BE Process Flow Design — Design the future-state automated order workflow in draw.io incorporating automated inventory reservation, dispatch notifications, and tracking.
User Stories & Acceptance Criteria — Write 12 clear Agile user stories formatted as 'As a [role], I want [action], so that [benefit]' with Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.

Backlog Management & MoSCoW Prioritization — Set up a free Jira or Trello project board, populate the backlog with epics and user stories, and prioritize them using MoSCoW (Must, Should, Could, Won't).
Operational KPI Definition — Define 6 essential fulfillment metrics in Excel: Order Lead Time, On-Time In-Full (OTIF) rate, Return Rate, Fulfillment Cost Per Order, and CSAT score.
Operational KPI Dashboard — Build a clean Excel or Power BI mockup dashboard displaying weekly order volume trends and fulfillment bottleneck alerts.
User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Plan — Draft a 10-scenario UAT test case matrix in Google Sheets covering order placement, payment verification, shipping updates, and customer returns.
Full Business Requirements Document (BRD) — Consolidate the project charter, process maps, user stories, KPI metrics, and UAT matrix into a formal, structured BRD document.
Stakeholder Walkthrough & GitHub Repository — Create a 10-slide executive summary presentation, record a 5-minute project overview video, and commit all project deliverables to GitHub.

projectDesc: Conduct UX research and design an intuitive, accessible patient portal mobile app. Create user personas, user journey maps, wireframes, an interactive Figma prototype, and a standardized design system component library.
tools: Figma, FigJam / Miro, Google Docs / Notion, Google Slides, GitHub
responsibilities: Analyze user needs, behaviors, and feedback to identify product and design opportunities.
Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, design systems, and product visualizations.
Conduct user research and validate designs for usability, clarity, and consistency.
Perform UX analysis to support product development and design decisions.
Collaborate with product managers, developers, and cross-functional teams on requirements.
Identify UX improvement opportunities through research, testing, and design analysis.
Track product and UX metrics to monitor engagement, adoption, and performance.
Conduct ad hoc analysis to address product and user experience challenges.
Maintain documentation for requirements, workflows, prototypes, and research activities.
Ensure designs follow usability, accessibility, consistency, and design standards.
Present design concepts, findings, solutions, and recommendations to stakeholders.
weekTasks: Competitive Analysis & UX Audit — Review 3 existing telehealth apps (e.g., Teladoc, MyChart, Zocdoc); document screen flows, navigation structures, and user friction points.
User Personas & Empathy Maps — Create 2 user personas (a busy working professional and a senior patient managing chronic medications) highlighting goals, frustrations, and device preferences.
User Journey & Task Flow Mapping — Map user flow in FigJam for two core tasks: booking a specialist appointment and reviewing lab test results.
Low-Fidelity Wireframes — Sketch low-fidelity wireframes in Figma for 5 key screens: Home Dashboard, Doctor Search, Appointment Booking, Prescription List, and Telehealth Video Call.
Design System Foundations — Build color styles (primary, neutral, semantic alerts), typography hierarchy, 8pt spacing grid, and standard icon set in Figma.
UI Component Library — Design reusable UI components in Figma with auto-layout: buttons, form inputs, doctor info cards, status badges, and bottom navigation.
High-Fidelity Screens: Booking Flow — Design polished high-fidelity mobile screens for selecting doctor specialties, available dates/times, and confirming appointments.
High-Fidelity Screens: Health Records & Consult — Design high-fidelity screens for lab results overview, medication refills, and doctor consultation notes.
Clickable Interactive Prototype — Connect Figma screens with interactive transitions and click triggers to create a smooth, testable mobile prototype.
Usability Testing & Feedback Synthesis — Conduct a usability walkthrough session with 3 peers, test the appointment booking flow, and log usability findings in a feedback matrix.
Accessibility Audit & Design Polish — Check contrast ratios against WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards, refine tap targets, and prepare developer handoff documentation with component tokens.
Design Portfolio Case Study & Demo — Create a 10-slide case study presentation deck, record a 5-minute interactive Figma walkthrough video, and publish documentation and exports to GitHub.

name: Sandeep Kasiraju
project: Predictive Customer Purchase & Sales Revenue Forecasting Engine
projectDesc: Develop a machine learning prediction pipeline using Python and scikit-learn. Perform EDA, feature engineering, train classification and regression models to predict customer purchase intent, and deploy an interactive Streamlit web app.
tools: Python (pandas, scikit-learn, matplotlib, seaborn), Jupyter Notebook, Streamlit, GitHub
responsibilities: Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and business insights.
Develop, test and deploy statistical models, machine learning algorithms and predictive analytics solutions.
Design and maintain data pipelines, dashboards and reporting tools to support decision-making.
Perform exploratory data analysis and present findings to stakeholders in a clear and actionable manner.
Validate model performance and continuously optimize algorithms for accuracy and efficiency.
Utilize programming languages such as Python, R, SQL and relevant data science tools and frameworks.
Support data governance, quality assurance, and compliance with organizational data policies.
Stay current with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices in data science and artificial intelligence.
Identify opportunities for process automation and operational efficiency through data-driven solutions.
weekTasks: Environment Setup & Data Acquisition — Set up Python virtual environment with Jupyter, pandas, and scikit-learn; download Kaggle Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention dataset and verify summary stats.
Data Cleaning & Preprocessing — Clean dataset: check for null values, encode categorical variables (Month, VisitorType, Weekend) using LabelEncoder/OneHotEncoder, and document schema.
Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) — Create exploratory seaborn charts: correlation matrix heatmap, bounce rate vs. exit rate scatter plot, and purchase rate breakdown by visitor type.

Feature Engineering & Scaling — Create derived features (e.g., total session duration, page value ratios), split dataset into 80% train and 20% test sets, and scale numerical features with StandardScaler.
Baseline Model Training — Train a baseline Logistic Regression model to predict customer purchase intent (Revenue = True/False); calculate initial accuracy, precision, and confusion matrix.
Advanced Machine Learning Models — Train Random Forest and Gradient Boosting (or XGBoost) classifiers; evaluate precision, recall, F1-score, and ROC-AUC curve on the test dataset.
Hyperparameter Tuning — Run GridSearchCV or RandomizedSearchCV on the top-performing model to optimize hyperparameters (e.g., max_depth, n_estimators) for improved purchase prediction recall.
Feature Importance & Interpretability — Plot feature importance rankings to identify the top 5 factors influencing customer buying decisions (e.g., PageValues, ProductRelated duration).
Python Prediction Pipeline — Build an automated script (predict_pipeline.py) that loads the saved model using joblib and returns purchase probabilities on new batch CSV records.
Interactive Streamlit Web App — Build a simple Streamlit web interface (app.py) where business users can adjust session metric sliders and view real-time purchase predictions.
Model Evaluation & Business Insights Report — Write a 3-page report summarizing model benchmarks, key commercial drivers, and data governance practices implemented.
Code Quality & GitHub Portfolio — Clean Jupyter notebooks, add markdown explanations, freeze dependencies in requirements.txt, write a project README, commit to GitHub, and record a demo video.

name: Surendar Mourougan
project: Cloud-Native Task & Team Collaboration REST API Service
projectDesc: Build and deploy a secure, modular RESTful API service with Node.js/Express (or Python FastAPI), SQLite/PostgreSQL database, JWT authentication, and a clean web dashboard for team task management.
tools: Node.js / Express (or Python FastAPI), SQLite / PostgreSQL, Postman, HTML/CSS/JavaScript, Git, GitHub
responsibilities: Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications and systems.
Write clean, efficient, and scalable code following industry best practices.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and analyze business requirements.
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve software defects and technical issues.
Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and maintainability.
Develop and integrate APIs, databases, and third-party services as required.
Ensure application performance, security, and reliability standards are met.
Prepare and maintain technical documentation for developed applications and processes.
Stay updated with emerging technologies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
Assist in software deployment, upgrades, and production support activities.
weekTasks: Development Environment & Project Scaffold — Initialize Node.js/Express (or Python FastAPI) project, configure Git repository, set up .gitignore and package.json, and build a working GET /api/health endpoint.

Database Architecture & Schema — Design relational database schema for Users and Tasks (id, title, description, status, priority, dueDate, userId); initialize SQLite database and write migration scripts.
Basic CRUD API Endpoints — Build foundational endpoints: GET /api/tasks (fetch all tasks) and POST /api/tasks (create a new task); verify JSON responses in Postman.
Complete CRUD Functionality — Add GET /api/tasks/:id (fetch single task), PUT /api/tasks/:id (update status/details), and DELETE /api/tasks/:id (remove task); handle 404 not found errors.
User Authentication & Security — Implement POST /api/auth/register and POST /api/auth/login endpoints with password hashing (bcrypt) and JSON Web Token (JWT) issuance.
Protected Routes & Authorization Middleware — Create JWT verification middleware to restrict task endpoints so authenticated users can only view and manage their own tasks.
Input Validation & Error Handling — Add request payload validation middleware (validating required title, valid status values, date formats) and centralized error handling.
Search, Filter & Pagination — Enhance GET /api/tasks endpoint with query parameters for status filtering (?status=completed), search keywords, and pagination (?page=1&limit=10).
Automated Unit & Integration Testing — Write automated test suites using Jest (or Pytest) testing auth registration, login, and task CRUD endpoints; verify all tests pass.
Frontend Web Client — Build a lightweight HTML/CSS/JavaScript web dashboard that interacts with the API via fetch() to display tasks, filter by status, and toggle completions.
API Documentation — Create a comprehensive API documentation reference (using Swagger UI, Postman Collection export, or Markdown table) specifying all paths, headers, and payload schemas.
Containerization & GitHub Repository — Create a Dockerfile for containerized execution, write a detailed README.md with setup/run instructions, push to GitHub, and record a 5-minute demo video.
